name: Chaos Jenga
desc:
In Chaos Jenga, you are either a Survivor or the Attacker! 

💥 Attacker: THROW props to knock down the tower and eliminate EVERYONE!
🛡️ Survivors: SURVIVE until the timer runs out, or reach the bottom of the tower to ESCAPE!

🤝 This game requires 2 people to play, invite your friends!

💖 LIKE and FAVOURITE the game, it helps a lot!
